name: Henry W. Coe
bio: Dr. Henry W. Coe of Mandan was nominated for the territorial legislature in October 1884 and represented Medora's district. In 1885 he closed up Coll McClellan's census work at Medora, and in fall 1886 he inspected an Oliver County herd reported to have pleuro-pneumonia.
